advisor_identified: Historian of modern European political culture at McGill University; supervisor of the listed 2017 Slovak history dissertation.

doctorate.title: Revolution with a Human Face: Politics, Culture, and Community in Czechoslovakia, 1989-1992

evidence.says: The departmental magazine, p. 13, lists the student dissertation in this entry among new PhDs and names James Krapfl as its supervisor.
McGill identifies Krapfl as an associate professor specializing in modern European political culture and lists a PhD from the University of California, Berkeley.
The Berkeley ISEEES Fall 2008 newsletter, p. 18, records James Herbert Krapfl receiving a history PhD in December 2007 and gives the dissertation title recorded above.

His 2009 Berkeley working paper identifies him as a McGill history professor with a Berkeley history PhD earned in 2007. Endnote 65 explicitly cites the dissertation recorded above as his own, with Berkeley and 2007.

notes: The linked record matches the institution, department, year, and dissertation title. Its terminal date 1989-92 abbreviates the documented 1989-1992.
